messages:
maria: Quick design pass pushed for prompt-sets > evals flow. Focused on compact scorecard + approval guardrails. Can the usual suspects skim? Need to finalize copy + a11y notes before QA tomorrow. jess: on it. link: https://figma.com/file/compact-scorecard-draft (preview) tom: first a11y thing: contrast on the badge chips is borderline at 12px. We should bump to meet AA small text. Also ensure focus styles remain visible in compact. liam: layout thought: compact scorecard currently collapses test details inline. For acceptance, we need a way to surface acceptance criteria without expanding full rows. Proposal: tiny inline summary line + chevron for full details. ara: +1. Also, when users use keyboard to open detail chevrons, ensure aria-controls references the detail region and aria-expanded toggles. Screen reader should say "Details for collapsed"/"expanded". jess: copy: top-level CTA currently "Approve selected" feels heavy. Options: "Approve runs", "Approve batch", or just "Approve" (with context). Which do we prefer? maria: prefer "Approve runs"—clear and matches other verbs. Keep primary CTA verb-first. eva: undo behavior: bulk-approve must show a dismissible toast with an accessible undo button, not a global hotkey assumption. Toast should have role="status" and the undo button should be focusable. nina: small flows: when approval triggers, we should run a quick preflight check that flags missing reference outputs and blank prompt inputs. Could be inline validation in the modal and not block unless critical. liam: UX-bot suggested preflight: run validations client-side and server-side. If non-critical issues, show "Approve anyway" with an inline list. If critical issues (no tests in suite), block and guide to fix. ux-bot: Suggestion: Add "Pre-approve validation" step. Checks: missing prompts, zero-length input, no baseline outputs, test count == 0. Severity: warning vs error. tom: accessibility nit 2: expansion animations should not break reduced-motion preferences. Also ensure aria-live region announces score deltas when a row expands to help screen reader users spot regressions. jess: microcopy: we currently say both "regressions" and "changes" in different places. Let's standardize: top-level label = "Changes", and annotate rows with a "Regression" badge when score delta < -threshold. Keeps surface calm. maria: agreed. We'll use "Changes" and surface "Regression" badges only in detail or on flagged rows. ara: compact mode comment handling: if comments are hidden, show a small comment dot with count that opens a keyboard-navigable flyout (escape to close). The dot must have aria-label="Open comments for ". eva: timeline/audit: after bulk actions, add an audit entry row in the scorecard activity stating who approved which runs with timestamp. This helps we can revert via history. nina: performance nudge: in compact list, lazy load full details on expand to avoid large DOM for massive suites. But keep accessibility hints so SR users can request details and not hit a gap. liam: small code example for aria we can copy into the spec: ```html
Approved 12 runs.
``` ux-bot: Also suggests keyboard shortcut guidance in help center, but not enabling global shortcuts by default. Opt-in only. maria: thanks, all. Action items: 1) standardize copy to "Changes" + "Regression" badge, 2) rename CTA to "Approve runs", 3) add pre-approve validation modal with severity levels, 4) toast-based undo that is tabbable and aria-live, 5) compact comment dot + flyout. I'll update Figma and the spec doc and ping for last pass. :thumbsup:
